name: Community

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: When the legitimacy of his degree is challenged, lawyer Jeff Winger must return to school, where he meets a clan of misfit community college students.

videos.title: Spanish 101
videos.overview: While Jeff looks to use a Spanish class assignment to get close to Britta, Pierce has something altogether different in mind.

videos.title: Introduction to Film
videos.overview: Jeff struggles to get a good grade, and Britta's offer to bankroll his film class exposes a rift between Abed and his angry father.

videos.title: Social Psychology
videos.overview: As Annie recruits Abed and Troy for a psychology class experiment, Jeff and Shirley bond over their mutual fondness for gossip.

videos.title: Advanced Criminal Law
videos.overview: As Pierce volunteers to compose a new school song, a cheating episode in Spanish class leaves Jeff defending Britta before a disciplinary tribunal.

videos.title: Football, Feminism and You
videos.overview: Annie's dream of being the ex-football star's girlfriend is in jeopardy when Jeff is blackmailed into getting Troy to join Greendale's football team.

videos.title: Introduction to Statistics
videos.overview: Jeff sets his sights on an attractive professor, and Annie looks to boost her social standing by hosting a Day of the Dead party.

videos.title: Home Economics
videos.overview: Jeff is forced out of his condo and into Abed's dorm room, and Annie looks to get Troy's attention by helping him plan a romantic picnic.

videos.title: Debate 109
videos.overview: As Jeff is drafted to help lead Greendale's debate team against the formidable City College, Abed's film-class projects appear to predict the future.

videos.title: Environmental Science
videos.overview: Faced with an unreasonable amount of Spanish homework, Jeff's efforts to handle Señor Chang manage to help him, but not the rest of the class.

videos.title: The Politics of Human Sexuality
videos.overview: With his high-price "escort" girlfriend on his arm, Pierce pressures Jeff into asking Dean Pelton's airhead secretary to double date at the STD Fair.

videos.title: Comparative Religion
videos.overview: Shirley's plans for a holiday party are in jeopardy when Jeff is drawn into a fight with a campus bully.

videos.title: Investigative Journalism
videos.overview: Jeff accepts an invitation to be the editor of the school paper as he and his friends fend off an interloper who wants to join their study group.

videos.title: Interpretive Dance
videos.overview: As Jeff and Prof. Slater try to keep their student-teacher romance under wraps, Britta and Troy tell everyone about their shared passion for dance.

videos.title: Romantic Expressionism
videos.overview: Jeff and Britta team up to derail Annie's fledgling romance with Greendale's resident hippie singer-songwriter, Vaughn.

videos.title: Communication Studies
videos.overview: As Valentine's Day finds Jeff struggling with his feelings for Britta and Professor Slater, Pierce and Troy are wrongly blamed for a prank.

videos.title: Physical Education
videos.overview: The study group helps Abed land a date with a girl, and Jeff squares off with a P.E. coach who insists that he wear gym shorts to a billiards class.

videos.title: Basic Genealogy
videos.overview: As Family Day lands Jeff in the middle of an affair with Pierce's sexy ex-stepdaughter, Shirley's unruly sons help liberate Abed's Afghani cousin.

videos.title: Beginner Pottery
videos.overview: A pottery class he takes for an easy A reveals Jeff's deep-seated need to succeed.

videos.title: The Science of Illusion
videos.overview: When her April Fools' Day prank inadvertently sends a human cadaver out the anatomy lab window, Britta looks to place the blame on Jeff.

videos.title: Contemporary American Poultry
videos.overview: A scheme to replace a corrupt cafeteria employee transforms the study group into a criminal gang run by a power-hungry Abed.

videos.title: The Art of Discourse
videos.overview: While a tasteless prank ends with Pierce being tossed out of the group, Britta and Jeff are forced to team up against some teen newcomers at school.

videos.title: Modern Warfare
videos.overview: The first prize of priority registration engulfs Greendale Community College in a Spring Fling paintball war.

videos.title: English as a Second Language
videos.overview: On the eve of an important final exam in Spanish, everyone's grades are jeopardized when it is discovered that Señor Chang has a damaging secret.

videos.title: Pascal's Triangle Revisited
videos.overview: As the end of the school year finds Jeff at the apex of a romantic triangle, Annie ponders moving away with her hacky sack-playing boyfriend.

videos.title: Anthropology 101
videos.overview: When the semester starts, Jeff is stunned that his rejection of Britta has made her a campus star; Chang wants to be accepted into the study group.

videos.title: Accounting for Lawyers
videos.overview: When an old friend from Jeff's past appears unexpectedly, his friends discover that he was the one responsible for Jeff's disbarment.

videos.title: The Psychology of Letting Go
videos.overview: A death provokes a fierce debate about Pierce's religious beliefs. Britta and Annie are at odds over tactics in the Gulf oil spill fund-raising drive.

videos.title: Basic Rocket Science
videos.overview: Jeff and the group must salvage an aging museum exhibit that Dean Pelton wants as the centerpiece of Greendale's proposed aerospace training program.

videos.title: Messianic Myths and Ancient Peoples
videos.overview: Shirley and Abed are at odds over his plan to direct and star in his own epic religious film.

videos.title: Epidemiology
videos.overview: Dean Pelton's army surplus party food sparks an outbreak of zombie-ism at the Greendale Halloween party.

videos.title: Aerodynamics of Gender
videos.overview: Abed endears himself to the girls after he offers to take down their enemies on campus; Jeff and Troy stumble onto a groundskeeper's secret paradise.

videos.title: Cooperative Calligraphy
videos.overview: Annie's missing pen leads to friction within the group.

videos.title: Conspiracy Theories and Interior Design
videos.overview: When Jeff tries to obtain credit for a fictitious class, the unintended consequences rock Greendale. Abed and Troy build an elaborate blanket fort.

videos.title: Mixology Certification
videos.overview: Troy's friends help him celebrate his 21st birthday.

videos.title: Abed's Uncontrollable Christmas
videos.overview: The meaning of Christmas is lost and Abed's intense fixation on the holiday concerns the group in this special stop-motion animation episode.

videos.title: Asian Population Studies
videos.overview: With Chang pressing for membership in the study group, Annie's latest crush has Jeff reeling as Shirley unveils some stunning news.

videos.title: Celebrity Pharmacology
videos.overview: Pierce's efforts to bribe director Annie may undermine the theater group's antidrug play; Jeff's texting prank puts Britta in an awkward situation.

videos.title: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons
videos.overview: Abed invites "Fat Neil" to play a game of Dungeons & Dragons with the rest of the study group, hoping to boost his confidence, after Jeff becomes concerned about him being a loner. When Pierce finds out he was not invited, he joins anyway, disrupting their plans.

videos.title: Early 21st Century Romanticism
videos.overview: On Valentine's Day, Troy and Abed compete for the attention of an assistant librarian, while Britta tries to show she's open-minded about lesbians.

videos.title: Intermediate Documentary Filmmaking
videos.overview: Claiming that he is about to die, Pierce summons the study group to the hospital to bequeath his belongings to them.

videos.title: Intro to Political Science
videos.overview: For an upcoming vice-presidential visit, Glendale's Dean Pelton hastily organizes an election for student body president that pits Annie against Jeff.

videos.title: Custody Law and Eastern European Diplomacy
videos.overview: Although Shirley and Andre don't want Chang involved with her baby, he resolves to be a good dad. Abed and Troy's new friend may be a war criminal.

videos.title: Critical Film Studies
videos.overview: Jeff and the group arrange a Pulp Fiction birthday party for Abed, but he has his own plans, starting with an expensive dinner for himself and Jeff.

videos.title: Competitive Wine Tasting
videos.overview: Jeff is suspicious of Pierce's engagement to a pretty classmate. Troy invents a childhood trauma to impress Britta, and Abed challenges a professor.

videos.title: Paradigms of Human Memory
videos.overview: Working on their final anthropology diorama, Chang finds a cache of items stolen by Troy's monkey that dredge up unhappy memories for the study group.

videos.title: Applied Anthropology and Culinary Arts
videos.overview: As the semester ends, the anthropology final is disrupted when Shirley goes into labor and her husband, Andre, is summoned to school for the birth.

videos.title: A Fistful of Paintballs (1)
videos.overview: A $100,000 paintball war prize pits members of the study group against one another, until they decide to join forces to stop a mysterious challenger.

videos.title: For a Few Paintballs More (2)
videos.overview: As the paintball war is revealed to be a City College plot, Jeff and Troy vie for control of Greendale's ragtag army, while Pierce betrays the group.

videos.title: Biology 101
videos.overview: As Jeff tries to keep Pierce from rejoining the study group, Dean Pelton faces off with Vice Dean Laybourne for control of Greendale.

videos.title: Geography of Global Conflict
videos.overview: As Annie competes with an overachieving rival in a Model United Nations competition, Jeff wrestles with his feelings for his ambitious friend.

videos.title: Competitive Ecology
videos.overview: The study group struggles to incorporate a fellow classmate while working on a project for Professor Kane's class.

videos.title: Remedial Chaos Theory
videos.overview: When Jeff introduces an element of randomness into Troy and Abed's housewarming party, reality splits into six timelines.

videos.title: Horror Fiction in Seven Spooky Steps
videos.overview: When a personality test suggests that one group member is a homicidal maniac, they use a series of scary Halloween stories to expose the killer.

videos.title: Advanced Gay
videos.overview: When a drag queen's song makes Hawthorne Wipes an iconic gay product, Pierce embraces it, until his homophobic dad shows up to squelch the idea.

videos.title: Studies in Modern Movement
videos.overview: Annie has second thoughts about moving in with Troy and Abed once she realizes that they expect her to live in a blanket fort.

videos.title: Documentary Filmmaking: Redux
videos.overview: As Dean Pelton films a new commercial for Greendale, the production takes a wild turn once he discovers that a famous alum has agreed to appear in it.

videos.title: Foosball and Nocturnal Vigilantism
videos.overview: When Shirley agrees to coach Jeff in foosball, they realize that she bullied him mercilessly when they were kids.

videos.title: Regional Holiday Music
videos.overview: The study group is slowly convinced to fill in for the Glee Club at Greendale's Christmas pageant.

videos.title: Urban Matrimony and the Sandwich Arts
videos.overview: When Shirley's remarriage to Andre threatens to put her dreams of starting a business with Pierce on hold, Britta steps in.

videos.title: Contemporary Impressionists
videos.overview: The study group must work as celebrity impersonators at a bar mitzvah to pay off Abed's debt to a talent agency owner.

videos.title: Digital Exploration of Interior Design (1)
videos.overview: When Britta falls for the human embodiment of the Subway sandwich chain, Shirley and Pierce hope to use the situation to their advantage.

videos.title: Pillows and Blankets (2)
videos.overview: The students of Greendale are drawn into an epic pillow fight as Troy and Abed start a war that threatens to destroy their unique friendship.

videos.title: Origins of Vampire Mythology
videos.overview: When a carnival comes to Greendale, Annie goes to great lengths to make sure that Britta doesn't contact her carnival worker ex-boyfriend.

videos.title: Virtual Systems Analysis
videos.overview: After sending Troy and Britta on a date, Annie volunteers to keep Abed company in his Dreamatorium.

videos.title: Basic Lupine Urology
videos.overview: When the yam the study group was growing for biology class is killed, Troy and Abed are on the case.

videos.title: Course Listing Unavailable
videos.overview: After a classmate suddenly dies, the study group decides to host a memorial, but Jeff turns his speech into an angry anti-Greendale rant.

videos.title: Curriculum Unavailable
videos.overview: After Abed is caught trespassing at Greendale, he and his friends visit a psychiatrist.

videos.title: Digital Estate Planning
videos.overview: Pierce and his closest friends are summoned to Hawthorne Labs to play a video game that will determine who will inherit his father's fortune.

videos.title: The First Chang Dynasty
videos.overview: The study group stages an elaborate heist to break in to Greendale and free Dean Pelton from the clutches of Chang.

videos.title: Introduction to Finality
videos.overview: Jeff agrees to represent Shirley in a case against Pierce to determine official ownership of their new sandwich shop.

videos.title: History 101
videos.overview: As Jeff competes for spots in an overbooked 'History of Ice Cream' class, Abed copes with the looming end of their time at Greendale by retreating into a surreal mental 'happy place', while Annie and Shirley engage in school-wide pranks.

videos.title: Paranormal Parentage
videos.overview: On the way to a Halloween party, the study group must free Pierce from his panic room and slowly comes to suspect that his mansion is haunted.

videos.title: Conventions of Space and Time
videos.overview: Troy worries about losing Abed to a fellow Inspector Spacetime fan at a convention for the show, while Annie fantasizes about being married to Jeff.

videos.title: Alternative History of the German Invasion
videos.overview: The study group contends with a group of German students who take over the study room. Chang makes his return to campus.

videos.title: Cooperative Escapism in Familial Relations
videos.overview: Britta joins Jeff to see his estranged father on Thanksgiving. Shirley invites the rest of the group to spend the holiday with her judgmental in-laws.

videos.title: Advanced Documentary Filmmaking
videos.overview: Greendale comes together to get to the bottom of Chang's amnesia, which Abed films as a documentary. Jeff, however, suspects Chang is faking it.

videos.title: Economics of Marine Biology
videos.overview: Dean Pelton enlists the study group to beautify the campus to woo a wealthy student to Greendale. A class on teaching P.E. pits Shirley against Troy.

videos.title: Herstory of Dance
videos.overview: Jeff sets out to embarrass Britta when she announces a dance for women's empowerment. Abed dreams of shuttling between two dates in one night.

videos.title: Intro to Felt Surrogacy
videos.overview: Dean Pelton prompts the study group to use puppets to relive the traumatic events of a recent adventure.

videos.title: Intro to Knots
videos.overview: Jeff organizes a lovely holiday gathering at his apartment, but Annie secretly invites Professor Cornwallis to get in his good graces.

videos.title: Basic Human Anatomy
videos.overview: When Annie and Shirley learn that Leonard is actually holding the spot as the class valedictorian, they join forces to bring him down.

videos.title: Heroic Origins
videos.overview: Abed's research into the study group's history uncovers an overlooked series of chance encounters that led each of them to Greendale.

videos.title: Advanced Introduction to Finality
videos.overview: A plan to celebrate Jeff's early graduation is unexpectedly disrupted by the study group's evil doppelgangers from the Darkest Timeline.

videos.title: Repilot
videos.overview: With his law practice doomed, Jeff returns to Greendale to start a class action suit against the school, but a hologram of Pierce has him reconsider.

videos.title: Introduction to Teaching
videos.overview: Abed tackles a two-day crash course on Nicolas Cage, while a clueless Jeff begins his teaching career with Annie as his most demanding student.

videos.title: Basic Intergluteal Numismatics
videos.overview: With the mysterious Ass Crack Bandit back at Greendale, Annie and Jeff are on the case. As clues and suspicions mount, Shirley delivers shocking news.

videos.title: Cooperative Polygraphy
videos.overview: Pierce's funeral leaves the study group with mixed feelings, especially after their late tormentor leaves one last test to reveal everyone's secrets.

videos.title: Geothermal Escapism
videos.overview: For Troy's last day at Greendale, Abed holds a campus-wide "hot lava" fantasy game. With a comic book worth $50,000 as the prize, it's an all-out war.

videos.title: Analysis of Cork-Based Networking
videos.overview: While Annie and Hickey's fight to get a bulletin board repaired spirals out of control, Abed and Britta go to war over spoilers of his favorite show.

videos.title: Bondage and Beta Male Sexuality
videos.overview: Jeff counsels a smitten Duncan on how to get a date with Britta but is developing feelings of his own. An angry Hickey tries to teach Abed a lesson.

videos.title: App Development and Condiments
videos.overview: A new caste system takes over when Greendale beta tests an app that ranks everyone. Shirley loves her new status, but Jeff and Britta want it stopped.

videos.title: VCR Maintenance and Educational Publishing
videos.overview: Abed and Annie try to solve their new roommate dilemma with a retro VCR game, while Jeff, Shirley and Hickey hatch a plan to sell stolen textbooks.

videos.title: Advanced Advanced Dungeons & Dragons
videos.overview: To help Hickey be a more involved grandfather, which means patching up a bad relationship with his son, the gang creates an epic role-playing game.

videos.title: G.I. Jeff
videos.overview: Jeff's depression over turning 40 leads him to drink himself unconscious. In his dreams, he and the gang are part of the "G. I. Joe" cartoon team.

videos.title: Basic Story
videos.overview: The Save Greendale Committee's success is short-lived when the board votes for a corporate sellout, but Pelton, Annie and Abed might find a solution.

videos.title: Basic Sandwich
videos.overview: To save Greendale from being sold, the gang searches for an eccentric computer science professor's legendary treasure hidden beneath the school.

videos.title: Ladders
videos.overview: New administrative consultant Frankie's strict — and sobering — changes split the group when Abed goes rogue to side with the enemy.

videos.title: Lawnmower Maintenance and Postnatal Care
videos.overview: When Dean Pelton loses himself — and a chunk of the college budget — in a virtual reality system, Jeff seeks help from its cantankerous inventor.

videos.title: Basic Crisis Room Decorum
videos.overview: A rival's attack ad puts the group into defensive mode — and a moral quandary. Britta and Chang find new ways to gross everyone out.

videos.title: Queer Studies & Advanced Waxing
videos.overview: Dean Pelton's sexuality gives him an uncomfortable edge for a school board seat. Chang scores a surprise win in a stage adaptation of "The Karate Kid."

videos.title: Laws of Robotics and Party Rights
videos.overview: When prisoners roll into Greendale via telerobot, Jeff meets his match in a clever convict. Britta's plans for a raging house party backfire.

videos.title: Basic Email Security
videos.overview: A hacker angry over a racist comic's planned campus performance threatens to publish the activity committee's personal emails.

videos.title: Advanced Safety Features
videos.overview: Britta's ex-boyfriend, Rick, returns, reigniting her far-fetched dreams of a normal relationship. Jeff goes to extremes to win Elroy over.

videos.title: Intro to Recycled Cinema
videos.overview: A commercial catchphrase catapults Chang to viral fame and a life-changing move. The group bands together to make movie magic for Abed.

videos.title: Grifting 101
videos.overview: Visiting Professor DeSalvo gives Jeff and his friends a master class in grifting and a bonus lesson on the art of revenge.

videos.title: Basic RV Repair and Palmistry
videos.overview: A 19-foot plaster hand guides the group on an emotional journey as they travel through mountains and flashbacks while aboard Elroy's RV.

videos.title: Modern Espionage
videos.overview: Heroes are born, promises are broken and the stakes are raised when paintball makes an explosive return to Greendale's campus.

videos.title: Wedding Videography
videos.overview: When two Greendale students get married, the wedding reception takes a turn after Jeff unwittingly exposes an inconvenient truth.

videos.title: Emotional Consequences of Broadcast Television
videos.overview: The former study group's future — and friendships — are put to a test when one chapter of their lives closes and a new one begins.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 25 wins & 90 nominations total
